name: GC AI
description:
GC AI is the AI assistant built for in-house legal teams. This connector brings your GC AI workspace into Claude so you can work with your own documents, playbooks, and matters directly in the conversation.

With the GC AI connector you can:

Ask legal questions grounded in your organization’s knowledge base, with answers cited to your own files rather than the open web.
Run document-review playbooks (contract review, redlining, issue-spotting) over files you upload or that already live in GC AI, and get the results back in chat.
Upload documents into GC AI and track them through text extraction and indexing until they are ready to use.
Organize work into projects: create them, attach and detach files, and keep related matters together.
Create and update reusable skills and playbooks so your team’s review standards stay consistent.
Everything runs against your existing GC AI account and stays scoped to your organization, so answers reflect your documents and your team’s work. Sign in with your GC AI credentials to connect.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GC AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GC AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.gc.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GC AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GC AI lists 20 MCP tools, including ask_gcai, ask_gcai_save_chat, ask_gcai_status, attach_to_project, create_playbook, create_project, create_skill, detach_from_project, finish_file_upload, get_files, get_playbooks, and get_projects.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GC AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GC AI in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.

_published_faq.name: Does GC AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: GC AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
GC AI is developed by GC AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
